user.title: Set up doorbell
user.description: Doorbell button: Shelly 1 (Gen1). The Shelly reports a ring via webhook; its relay drives the mechanical chime. Only enter username and password if login protection (Restrict login) is enabled on the Shelly.

data.name: Doorbell name
data.shelly_host: IP address or hostname of the Shelly

data_description.name: Used as device name and shown in HomeKit, e.g. "Front door".
data_description.shelly_host: Static IP address or hostname in the LAN, e.g. 192.168.1.50. The Shelly must be reachable (connection test).
data_description.shelly_username: Leave empty if no login is configured on the Shelly.
data_description.shelly_password: Password of the Shelly login; leave empty if no login is configured.

camera.title: Select camera
camera.description: The camera is passed through a dedicated camera entity of this doorbell so that HomeKit recognizes camera and button as one video doorbell. Recommendation for Reolink: sub or fluent stream in H.264.{detached_hint}

data_description.camera_entity: Camera entity whose picture HomeKit shows when someone rings, e.g. from Reolink.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Shelly credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The Shelly {host} rejects the stored credentials. Please enter the credentials configured on the Shelly under *Settings → Restrict login*.

data_description.shelly_username: Leave empty if login has since been disabled on the Shelly.

reconfigure.title: Change doorbell

data.shelly_host: IP address or hostname of the Shelly

reconfigure.description: Change address, credentials or camera. The Shelly is checked again; it must be the same Shelly (same MAC address).

data_description.shelly_host: Static IP address or hostname in the LAN, e.g. 192.168.1.50.
data_description.shelly_username: Leave empty if no login is configured on the Shelly.
data_description.shelly_password: Leave empty to keep the current password (with the same username).
data_description.camera_entity: Camera entity whose picture HomeKit shows when someone rings.

error.cannot_connect: The Shelly cannot be reached. Check IP address and network.
error.invalid_auth: The Shelly rejects username or password.
error.not_shelly_gen1: No first-generation Shelly (Gen1) responds at this address. Shelly Plus/Pro (Gen2 and newer) are not supported.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Shelly is already set up as a doorbell.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: A different Shelly responds at the new address.

create_entry.default:
The doorbell has been set up.

**Webhook URL for the Shelly:**
`{webhook_url}`

On the Shelly (web interface): set *Settings → Button Type → Detached Switch* and *I/O URL actions → BUTTON SWITCHED ON URL* = the URL above, enable and save. The URL is also shown in the doorbell options.

Then let the HomeKit accessory be created under *Settings → Repairs*.

init.title: Doorbell options
init.description:
**Webhook URL for the Shelly:**
`{webhook_url}`

Enter it on the Shelly under *I/O URL actions → BUTTON SWITCHED ON URL*. Plain HTTP within the local network only.

data.restrict_ip: Only accept the webhook from the Shelly's IP
data.allowed_ip: Different allowed IP address or hostname (optional)

data_description.allowed_ip: Leave empty = IP address of the Shelly.
data_description.auto_off: Applies to the binary sensor "Ringing" (fallback sensor). The doorbell event itself has no duration.
data_description.notify_services: notify services, e.g. mobile_app_iphone. The snapshot is attached as an image.
data_description.notify_message: {name} is replaced by the doorbell name.
data_description.restrict_ip: Prevents false alarms from the network: webhook calls from other devices are rejected.
data_description.connectivity: Polls the Shelly regularly and shows the result in the binary sensor "Shelly reachable".

error.invalid_ip: Not a valid IP address or hostname.

confirm.title: Create HomeKit accessory
confirm.description:
A dedicated HomeKit accessory (mode "accessory") is created for the camera {camera_entity_id}. The HomeKit Bridge links this device's doorbell automatically, HomePods chime and the iPhone shows the camera picture.

Afterwards enter the pairing code from the notification in the Home app.

abort.already_exists: A HomeKit accessory already exists for {camera_entity_id}.
abort.camera_missing: The camera entity {camera_entity_id} is not available yet. Please try again later.
abort.homekit_failed: The HomeKit accessory could not be created automatically. Please create it manually: Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → HomeKit Bridge; then in the options of this new bridge select mode "accessory" and the camera {camera_entity_id}. See the README for details.

eingang_nicht_entkoppelt.title: Shelly input of {name} is not detached
eingang_nicht_entkoppelt.description:
The Shelly {host} uses input mode "{btn_type}". In this mode the doorbell button switches the relay directly and the switch "Mechanical chime" cannot mute the chime.

On the Shelly select "Detached Switch" under *Settings → Button Type*. This notice disappears the next time the doorbell is reloaded.
